medium: interview on camera against a bookshelf, white serif captions mid-frame; cutaways are documentary news footage and news photos of public figures
avoid: illustration, cartoon, 3D render, studio lighting, stock-photo gloss, text baked into the image
note: Two interviewees, both non-generatable, as are the news stills of real public figures. Captions sit mid-frame, so reference stills are cropped to the top 57% to keep them out. Caption: white bold serif, centred, short phrases.

looks.label: Interviewee at the bookshelf
looks.when: the interviewee on camera - never generated.

looks.label: Documentary news footage
looks.when: a place, a workplace, an institution, an event in the real world - shown as filmed news footage.
looks.prompt: Documentary news footage: the subject filmed in the real world with a handheld camera - a field, a shop counter, a corridor, a yard - natural available light, slightly soft broadcast video, a little motion blur, muted true-to-life colour, people only at a distance or from behind. No text.

looks.label: News article screenshot
looks.when: a report, a study, a headline, a published claim - shown as a screenshot of the article.
looks.prompt: A screenshot of an online news article floating over a dark blurred background: white page, a small masthead line at the top, a large bold serif headline as two or three lines of grey illegible text, a byline line, and a photo below the headline. No real publication name, no readable words.

looks.label: News still of a public figure
looks.when: a named public figure - real news footage only, never generated.
